To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
fine-grain power measurements can be used to analyze the power consumption of embedded processors, and to detect potential vulnerabilities.

fine-grain (cycle-accurate) side-channel power analysis of a soft core processor is possible using FOBOS, that Hamming Distance and/or Hamming Weight power models can be used to analyze side-channel vulnerabilities of a soft core implementation of AES, and that the Hamming Distance power models used in previous research are not sufficient to characterize the power behavior of load-to-register instructions in this processor architecture.

the vulnerability analysis of embedded microprocessors in reconfigurable architectures through fine-grain power profiling.
